title: Shell an edamame pod into a serving bowl
instruction: Open the edamame pod, put all three beans in the serving bowl, and discard the empty pod in the food-scraps bin.
context: A real-size household food preparation task combining bimanual pod opening, extraction, and waste sorting.
setup: A closed 66 mm green pod containing three individual 9–10 mm beans rests on a ceramic plate. A serving bowl and an open food-waste caddy stand nearby.
scoring: Require intact containment at reset and actual handling of both halves. Score 0.25 for all three seam bonds released and opening above 35°, 0.50 for one extracted bean fully inside the bowl, 0.70 for two, and 0.85 for all three. Full credit requires all shell sections inside the bin and one second of stable retention with hands clear. A bean or shell section lost off the tabletop invalidates the trial.
fidelity: Continuous concave shell with segmented flex, a distributed cohesive seam, and three colliding rigid beans. Geometry approximates a selected three-bean specimen. Material properties and seam strength are development estimates.
scores: Scripted expert: 1.00 at seed 0. Fresh repeat scores: 1.00 at seeds 0, 1 and 2. All expert trials completed in 1,502 actions. Independent Dream-1: 0.00 at seed 0 over 2,000 actions.
